title: Do Dense Retrievers Respect Emotion? Code and results
description: Code, selected hyper-parameters, metrics, p-values and per-query results for the paper "Do Dense Retrievers Respect Emotion? Measuring and Improving Emotional Consistency in Retrieval" (Islam Sadat and Samir Kechid). The EmpatheticDialogues and ESConv corpora are not redistributed; a script downloads them from their official sources.
